spec.name: Orange Kitchen Activity HUD tools
spec.description: Sixteen distinct kitchen activity sprites in a transparent 256×256 atlas, arranged in the requested 4×4 order. Every sprite stays inside its cell's central 48×48 area. Warm wood, ivory ceramics, sage accents and brass fittings use crisp upper-left lighting. No backgrounds or lettering.

prompt: Create one transparent 256x256 pixel-art sprite sheet for Orange SMP Kitchen. Exactly 4 columns by 4 rows of 64x64 cells. Each tool entirely fits within the CENTER 48x48 of its cell with 8px transparent margins. NO backgrounds or letters. Row 1 left to right: small sandwich ingredient stack, chef knife, wooden mixing spoon with ceramic bowl, metal spatula. Row 2: fryer wire basket, rice paddle with rice bowl, bamboo sushi mat with roll, wooden rolling pin. Row 3: pizza peel with small pizza, oven mitt with cookie, copper ladle and stockpot, black wok tossing vegetables. Row 4: bamboo steamer basket, smoker thermometer and woodchips, blender with pink smoothie, espresso portafilter and milk jug. Consistent polished vanilla Minecraft pixel art, warm materials, ivory food, sage/brass kitchen accents, clear distinct silhouettes. All sixteen sprites must occupy their assigned cell.
